facts.fact: The Reporter states that the Ministry of Agriculture, through SADP II with WFP, supported a 2025/26 weather-index insurance pilot in Mafeteng, Mohale's Hoek and Quthing in which ARC used satellite observations to monitor crop water availability, with over US$1.2 million insured.
